items.title: Mrs. Cozzy Cary Interview, 1960-10-27
items.q: See, who had a band in Alexandria? John Thompson had a band up there, I believe. ... Did you ever hear that band? Uh-huh.

ctx.x: Fiddlers in the plantation? No, they had any plantations there.

All right. Let's see. We're talking to Ms. Elmore here right now. So we want to get when you were born and where. Well, I was born in 1902 in St. Mary Parish in a place called Glencoe, Louisiana, out from Franklin. That's near Baldwin or on the other side? Yeah, right near Baldwin. I know Jack Wilman from there. Jack Wilman, yeah. He's from Baldwin. Were you brought up in a church? You must have been. Yes. Which church was that? Methodist, ME. But I'm African Methodist now. You were just ME in those days? Uh-huh.…
Oh, yeah. I sing Dr. Watts.
